mapper.select: select s.id, s.session_key as sessionKey, s.user_id as userId, s.api_key_id as apiKeyId, s.model_code as modelCode, s.workspace_root as workspaceRoot, s.summary_text as summaryText, s.summary_message_id as summaryMessageId, s.last_response_id as lastResponseId, s.created_at as createdAt, s.updated_at as updatedAt from agent_sessions s join agent_messages m on m.session_id = s.id where m.response_id = #{responseId} and s.user_id = #{userId} order by s.id desc limit 1
